name: paperless-ngx-mcp
description: MCP server for Paperless-ngx document management. Search, browse, and manage documents and metadata.

paperless_url.title: Paperless-ngx URL
paperless_url.description: Base URL of your Paperless-ngx instance (e.g. http://localhost:8000)

paperless_token.title: Paperless-ngx API Token
paperless_token.description: API authentication token. Generate one in Paperless-ngx under Settings > Administration > Auth Tokens.

download_dir.title: Download Directory
download_dir.description: Optional directory for document downloads. When set, downloaded files are saved here with their real filenames and are not auto-cleaned. When unset, a temp directory is used.

content_snippet_bytes.title: Content Snippet Length (bytes)
content_snippet_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of document OCR content included per result in document_list and search_global. Set to 0 to disable truncation entirely.

tools.name: document_page_image
tools.description: Render a document page as a viewable image
